chunks: They will not be able to help them and will be brought (to Us) as their levied troops.
ai.seo_question: What happens to idols on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate futility of idolatry by depicting the idols not merely as silent objects, but as a 'gathered army' (junḍun muḥḍarūn) that will be brought forth to testify against their worshippers or be judged alongside them. This imagery underscores the concept of divine accountability where the instruments of misguidance become witnesses to the error of those who relied on them, reinforcing the monotheistic principle that only Allah possesses true power to aid or harm.
